stories.title: Nach gescheiterter Hinrichtung: Anwälte sprechen über Pikes Gesundheitszustand

en.title: After failed execution: Lawyers discuss Pike's health condition
en.summary: Convicted murderer Christa Pike survived two lethal injections during a scheduled execution last week. Her lawyers have disclosed details about her health status, including that she is suffering from pneumonia.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: Pellmann fordert: Merz muss Reihen in der CDU schließen

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Pellmann demands Merz close ranks within CDU
en.summary: Pellmann is calling on Merz to unite the CDU party.

stories.title: Hinrichtungsversuch in Tennessee: US-Amerikanerin kann nach überlebter Hinrichtung wieder sprechen

en.title: Execution attempt in Tennessee: American woman able to speak again after surviving execution
en.summary: Christa Pike is conscious following her failed execution attempt and her lawyers report she is angry and confused. They are demanding that no further execution attempt be made.

stories.title: Vier Stunden - dann ist der Koalitionsausschuss zu Ende

en.title: Four hours - then the coalition committee is finished
en.summary: The leadership of CDU, CSU and SPD concluded their coalition committee meeting late Wednesday evening. Further details are expected Thursday.

stories.title: Spanien: 87-jährige Spanierin stirbt nach Zwangsräumung in Madrid

en.title: Spain: 87-year-old Spanish woman dies after forced eviction in Madrid
en.summary: An 87-year-old Spanish woman died following a forced eviction from her home. She had been permitted to return to her apartment and became a symbol of Spain's housing crisis.

stories.title: Deutschland liveblog: Koalitionsausschuss nach vier Stunden beendet

en.title: Germany liveblog: Coalition committee ended after four hours
en.summary: A coalition committee meeting concluded after four hours with reportedly positive and constructive discussions. Results were to be communicated Thursday morning.

stories.title: Jahrestag des Hamas-Überfalls auf Israel: Greta Thunberg nimmt an pro-palästinensischer Demo in Berlin teil

en.title: Anniversary of Hamas attack on Israel: Greta Thunberg participates in pro-Palestinian demo in Berlin
en.summary: Hundreds gathered in Berlin on the anniversary of the Hamas attack on Israel for a pro-Palestinian demonstration. Activist Greta Thunberg was among the participants.

stories.title: Christa Pike: Anwälte schildern Gesundheitszustand nach gescheiterter Hinrichtung

en.title: Christa Pike: Attorneys describe health condition after failed execution
en.summary: Following a failed execution, Christa Pike suffers from pneumonia and is unable to eat or move her arms, according to her attorney. Her legal team is seeking access to evidence materials.

stories.title: Chemie-Nobelpreis geht an Henri Kagan und Kenso Soai - was das bedeutet

en.title: Chemistry Nobel Prize goes to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai - what it means
en.summary: Chemists Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the Nobel Prize for developing methods to control mirror-image molecular forms, preventing unwanted versions from appearing in medications.

stories.title: Merz über Sachsen-Anhalt: "Mit den Werten der CDU verträgt sich das nicht"

en.title: Merz on Saxony-Anhalt: "That is incompatible with CDU values"
en.summary: Chancellor Merz addresses concerns about whether CDU votes may have supported an AfD politician's election in Saxony-Anhalt, suggesting votes could have come from other parties.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: Merz: Stimmen für AfD-Mann unvereinbar mit Werten der CDU

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Merz says votes for AfD politician incompatible with CDU values
en.summary: Chancellor Merz stated that CDU members voting for an AfD politician undermine credibility and contradict party values. The source of four additional votes for AfD politician Tobias Rausch remains unclear.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: Merz hat ein neues AfD-Problem

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Merz has a new AfD problem
en.summary: The SPD concerns that potential CDU defectors might elect Ulrich Siegmund as minister-president. The party is calling for government intervention as the Union appears unsettled.

stories.title: Bundesregierung: Koalitionsausschuss beendet Sitzung nach vier Stunden

en.title: Federal government: Coalition committee ends session after four hours
en.summary: The German coalition committee concluded its first meeting in three months shortly after 10 p.m., ending earlier than typical sessions. Questions remain about a timeline for planned reforms.

stories.title: US-Staatsanleihen: US-Anleiheauktion: Starke Nachfrage bremst den Renditeanstieg

en.title: US Treasury bonds: Strong demand at US bond auction tempers yield gains
en.summary: Long-term US Treasury yields briefly reached their highest level since 2002 amid high oil prices and monetary policy pressures. Strong investor demand provided relief from rising rates.

stories.title: Fed-Protokolle: US-Zentralbank uneins über weiteren Zinserhöhungskurs

en.title: Fed Minutes: US Central Bank Divided Over Further Rate Hike Course
en.summary: Federal Reserve officials disagree on the path forward for monetary policy following the latest rate increase, with divisions evident regarding inflation, economic conditions, and future policy decisions.

stories.title: Deutschland-Gipfel: Wildberger: „Wir haben ein Umsetzungsproblem, aber auch ein Erkenntnisproblem. Und das ist massiv“

en.title: Germany Summit: Wildberger: "We Have an Implementation Problem, But Also a Knowledge Problem. And That's Massive"
en.summary: Germany's digital minister challenges a common coalition narrative at the summit, warning that Europe risks falling behind in artificial intelligence and identifying remaining opportunities.

stories.title: Deutschland-Gipfel: Frankreich als Vorbild: „Choose-France-Gipfel haben gezeigt, wie man durch gute Stimmung Investitionen ins Land holt“

en.title: Germany Summit: France as Role Model: "Choose-France Summits Have Shown How Good Sentiment Brings Investment into the Country"
en.summary: Despite facing debt and budget challenges, France attracts international capital more effectively through positive messaging than Germany, raising questions about federal government strategy.
